import json,re
fp='/Users/mac/.dc-platform/memory/mirrors/agent-transcripts/new-mac/14d76b95-0bec-46ec-a354-b89850de81a3/14d76b95-0bec-46ec-a354-b89850de81a3.jsonl'
# Get assistant text-only replies after key user turns (no tool_use only)
idxs_focus=set(range(546,660))
with open(fp) as f:
  lines=f.readlines()

def get_text(o):
  msg=o.get('message') if isinstance(o.get('message'),dict) else o
  role=msg.get('role') or o.get('role') or ''
  content=msg.get('content')
  texts=[]; tools=0
  if isinstance(content,list):
    for c in content:
      if isinstance(c,dict):
        if c.get('type')=='text': texts.append(c.get('text',''))
        elif c.get('type')=='tool_use': tools+=1
  elif isinstance(content,str): texts=[content]
  return role, '\n'.join(texts), tools

for i in range(546, len(lines)):
  o=json.loads(lines[i])
  role,text,tools=get_text(o)
  ts=re.search(r'<timestamp>(.*?)</timestamp>', text)
  ts=ts.group(1) if ts else ''
  if role=='user' and '<user_query>' in text:
    q=text.split('<user_query>',1)[1].split('</user_query>',1)[0].strip()
    print(f'\n### U[{i}] {ts}\n{q[:300]}\n')

    body=re.sub(r'\n{2,}','\n', text.strip())
    # skip brief inform boilerplate tiny
    if len(body)<20: continue
    print(f'--- A[{i}] ---\n{body[:1200]}\n')
  elif role=='assistant' and text.strip() and tools>0:
    # progress narration
    body=text.strip().split('\n')[0][:200]
